title: Metalworking
description: A simple mod that adds more tools and uses for metals
body:
# METALWORKING

## Features
- Hammers
- Metal Plates
- Metal Rods
- Copper Tools
- Copper Armor
- Armor and Tool Recipe Changes

## Hammers
Hammers are needed for crafting plates. They can also mine nine blocks at a time.

![Diamond Hammer Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/889528e37cbf6ec95de78559931082bf0da8172c.png)

## Armor & Tool Recipes
Armor is crafted with plates instead of ingots, making armor recipes twice as expensive.

![Diamond Chestplate Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0160eb8048c440889909e122b86272b8e36ec6c7.png)

Tools are crafted with rods instead of sticks. A diamond tool would need to be made with diamond rods.

![Diamond Pickaxe Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90ce52c0e2bae41b3741577d7ea08b551b9abd6d.png)
